receiving.title: Store payouts
receiving.intro: To receive payments through online checkout, connect your business Mercado Pago account and complete the identity verification requested by the provider. Check the account details before authorizing.
receiving.step1: Read the terms and connect your account.
receiving.step2: After authorizing on Mercado Pago, come back here and refresh the status.
receiving.step3: Check the account number and turn on online checkout.
receiving.moneyText: products and delivery are paid into the connected Mercado Pago account, minus processing fees. Release times and transfers follow that account’s terms. Connecting the account does not guarantee every payment will be approved.
receiving.feeText: {{fee}} per online order, added to the customer’s total and paid to the platform. The current amount is shown at checkout before confirmation.
receiving.cancelText: a refund covers both the store’s and the platform’s share. Keep a balance available and follow up on the result; requesting a refund does not mean it has been completed.
receiving.pixNote: Pix sent directly to your key and payments on delivery are not split automatically.
receiving.pending: Setup pending: connect your account to get paid online.
receiving.checkoutOn: Checkout turned on by the store
receiving.checkoutOff: Checkout turned off by the store
receiving.notReleased: Integrated checkout has not been enabled by the platform yet. The store’s current payment methods remain available.
receiving.terms: I understand where I will be paid, the Mercado Pago fees, the fee paid to DocePreço, and the refund terms.
receiving.enable: Turn on online checkout for this account
receiving.refundConfirm: Request a refund of the remaining balance of order #{{number}}? The order will be cancelled once the provider confirms.
receiving.paymentsHint: Amounts for up to 50 recent orders. Check your available balance and timelines on Mercado Pago; pending amounts have not been received yet.
